app: Adversarial round 2: leak audit of our own hardened distiller (mirror+extension of the macOS self-audit)
channel_setup: pages/leak-audit.html: bg-image logo, color-only status dot, shadow-DOM text, same-origin iframe. Naive hardened view vs patched distiller.

t1_read_text.detail: FOUR silent-leak classes found in our hardened distiller (after macOS found one): (1) shadow-DOM text invisible (TreeWalker doesn't descend); (2) iframes neither walked nor declared — worst case, invisible AND unsignalled; (3) CSS background-image content absent (a bg logo is neither text nor ); (4) color-only semantics dropped (a red status dot). All four closed: shadow roots recursed; same-origin iframes recursed WITH coordinate translation + own-document hit-testing (first patch emitted frame-local coords and false [occluded] — caught and fixed), cross-origin declared as [pixels] iframe; bg-image elements declared as [pixels] bg; small colored no-text elements emitted as `mark x,y,w,h color`. General styling semantics beyond marks remains a DOCUMENTED loss.

t2_enumerate.detail: Post-patch view: text+[pixels] bg+mark+shadow text+iframe text at main-page coords. Non-regressions green: occlusion page ([occluded] intact, no offscreen leak) and all-canvas ([pixels] canvas 0,0,1280,800).

t6_pictorial.detail: bg-image + iframe now declared; blind-spot accounting extended to non-element pictorial content.

measurements.notes: Key claim for the paper, refined: the completeness guarantee is a COVERAGE ACCOUNTING (every region readable, declared-opaque, or tagged-occluded), and it holds only as far as the distiller's enumeration of content classes. Each campaign found a class the previous one missed (macOS: opaque set; this round: shadow DOM, iframes, bg-image, color-only). The durable guarantee is therefore the runtime spot-check vs screenshot (safety property 3), not trust in any given distiller version.

runtime_verification.method: known sentinel strings/regions per class, before/after patch
runtime_verification.agreement: post-patch: all four classes visible or declared; zero silent survivors
